title: Fix Create User in Admin tools menu
description:
Create User in the Admin tools right-click menu is now a direct action that opens Settings with Create user expanded. The old flyout submenu was easy to miss beside the Folder system panel.

Who is affected: PipeShare BASE after deploy; SaaS after Push.
changeLog: Create User opens the admin create-user form in one click.
Module access settings stays as its own Admin tools item.
